source_notes.ny_transit_museum_ny: TEC event facts have blank descriptions; all eligible public pages are hydrated from every full narrative column and full accordion policy body. Five holiday rides use the publisher-named 2 Av–Houston boarding station and an official MTA entrance point. Four Grand Central/Penn walks use explicit approximate-meeting labels and verified station addresses. Two route-only walks lack a sufficiently bounded meeting venue and are held; seven members-only City Hall tours and one virtual program are excluded.
source_notes.brooklyn_childrens_museum_ny: Native Events Manager ICS provides full descriptions, explicit dated occurrences, and attachment images. The 50-row publisher feed ignores limit=200. A rolling 30-day window is enforced, with a horizon guard that fails if a full feed stops before the requested window. Member-only and closure notices are excluded. Ordinary Play at BCM programs retain their complete guided studio/makerspace session descriptions; no recurrence dates are invented.
source_notes.flushing_town_hall_ny: Native ARTdynamix detail #about is complete; the duplicated mobile block is excluded. Native performance tables supply exact start clocks. Six off-site named venues retain their own reviewed streets/points. Stone’s Throw has explicitly published Tue–Sun noon–6 exhibition hours through Nov15 and a separate Nov14 6:30 panel. One Zoom office-hours item is excluded.
source_notes.makerspace_nyc_ny: Official MakerSpace classes page links its own Eventbrite organizer18615337552/organization61731221749. Public Next.js HTML carries full text modules and native venue coordinates. Three multi-date parent events are expanded only from explicit dated session lines within the native series endpoints; no multi-month continuous event is published. Seven past/completed classes are excluded. Native sales state on_sale is used for evidence; SEO Offer availability can be stale and is not treated as an authoritative cancellation.
source_notes.brooklyn_public_library_presents_ny: Narrow BPL Presents series, not a claim of the entire citywide branch calendar. Ordinary Drupal HTML exposes 15 dated cards; 12 are within the rolling60-day window. Complete first content column preserves all biographies and program text; the Add-to-Calendar description is explicitly truncated and is never used. Each accepted native branch address/ZIP is checked against its exact branch identity, including the Dweck room and Arts & Culture Second Floor. Four reviewed NYC PAD points are attached. Listing, canonical URL, title, date/time, series tags and branch identity are verified; pagination changes fail closed.
